fix.item: Fixed JavaScript crash with Lenis/Astroid scroll integrations (`getAttribute is not a function`) by validating DOM elements before accessing attributes
Reworked typewriter initialization to use `DOMContentLoaded` (no `window.onload` override, fewer script conflicts)
Typewriter behavior changed to run once and stop after finishing the last configured text (no endless loop)
Restored support for speed/timing data attributes in script logic (`data-speed`, `data-start`, `data-end`, `data-dltSpeed`, `data-random`)

note.item: Changelog metadata update (2026-11-06): Release notes are now maintained as XML and published centrally at https://github.com/joomlaplates-de/changelogs. This package includes its release snapshot as changelog.xml.

addition.item: Module class suffix applied to wrapper in layout (mod_uk_typewriter + suffix)
README.md with install, config, override path and structure
Empty index.html in root, js, tmpl, language, language/en-GB
Event system: dispatch onContentPrepare for "Content Before" (J4/J5/J6; content plugins supported)
Language: MVC-conform language files (language/en-GB/mod_uk_typewriter.ini, .sys.ini); manifest uses language constants
Load mod_uk_typewriter language in entry point for Text::_() support

note.item: No database schema (module does not use custom tables)

addition.item: Use WebAssetManager for typewriter.js (J5/J6 best practice)
php_minimum 8.1 in manifest; fixed description typo in XML

fix.item: Joomla 5 and 6 compatibility: $params fallback when not in scope (with/without compatibility plugin)
XSS hardening: escaped output for class, data-text, and tag names; safe JSON for typewriter text

security.item: Whitelist type_font tag names; safe data-text via json_encode

fix.item: Changes Prefix. All modules have now the "JP"-Module Name
Ready for J5 and J6 without compatibility Plugin

remove.item: Removed the XML version. Not needed anymore for J5 or J6

fix.item: Changed the xml path for updates
